The '''Pirate Double Bed''' is a piece of [[furniture]] obtained from completing [[Penny#Fourteen Hearts|Penny's 14-Heart event]] (and choosing the Pirate Theme option).

If the original is lost, a replacement can be purchased at the [[Secret Woods#Lost Items Shop|Lost Items Shop]] in the Secret Woods for {{Price|10000}}.
